name: Las cosas de mi abuela
source:
Las cosas de mi abuela is a visual novel where you play as Carmen, a film student. During a visit to your grandparents' house, you find a mysterious box with three masks and some charming alebrijes, but are they really just that?

This game is inspired by films from the Golden Age of Mexican cinema. These films are not only part of a country's culture, but watching them is also part of our memories with our grandparents.

[From [url=https://urbi-lab.itch.io/las-cosas-de-mi-abuela]Itch.io[/url]]
